query:
SELECT searchId, COUNT(*) as total_visits, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN companyId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as matched
FROM leadinfo_visits 
GROUP BY searchId
ORDER BY searchId;
